card.name: Cross-reference cues in label text
card.fires_on: The word "see" inside bracketed cross-references like [see Warnings and Precautions (5.x)], and the word "Clinical Pharmacology" ending in "ology". Also fires on "e" in "e.g." inside parentheses.

modes.label: Bracketed see
modes.description: The word "see" right after an opening bracket that points to another label section.

modes.label: Pharmacology section name
modes.description: The final part of "Clinical Pharmacology" inside a see-reference.

modes.label: e.g. examples
modes.description: The letter e in e.g. opening a list of example drugs.
